  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    round_scores = case["round_scores"]
    round_targets = case["round_targets"]
    forced = set(case["forced"])
    n = len(round_scores[0])
    current_set = set(range(n))
    history = []
    for i in range(len(round_scores)):
        forced_in_round = forced & current_set
        target = round_targets[i]
        remaining = target - len(forced_in_round)
        candidates = current_set - forced_in_round
        if remaining > 0:
            scores = round_scores[i]
            selected = sorted(candidates, key=lambda idx: scores[idx], reverse=True)[:remaining]
        else:
            selected = []
        new_set = forced_in_round | set(selected)
        history.append(sorted(new_set))
        current_set = new_set
    retained = sorted(current_set)
    return {"history": history, "retained_indices": retained}"
}
